title: FoxEternity
description: Adds new neutron collectors and Avaritia automation
body:
# **FoxEternity** *** ### This mod is designed for GTNH version of mods!

 **FoxEternity** is an endgame-focused addon that brings true automation to the most overpowered mechanics in Minecraft - Avaritia⚡ > Infinity is no longer a grind — it’s a system. ## ⚡ What does this mod add? 🌌**Neutron Collectors** Generate resources at insane levels and push your progression into true endgame territory. ♾️**Avaritia Automation** Automate the most “impossible” crafting chains — no more manual suffering. ## 🔥Features * ♾️ Full integration with Avaritia * ⚡ High-tier resource generation * 🏭 Designed for endgame factories * 🧠 Smart automation mechanics * 🦊 Clean and powerful design ## 😏Why use it? ✔️ Because Avaritia is painful without automation ✔️ Because you want TRUE endgame power ✔️ Because grinding infinity items manually is... not it ✔️ Because automation solves everything ## ⚠️ Requirements * Minecraft **1.7.10 (Forge)** * **Avaritia GTNH Version** * **Applied Energistics 2 GTNH Version

** ## 🌐 Join the Community 💬 Got questions? Ideas? Found a bug? Join our Discord and be part of the project! 👉 **Discord:** **[\-2 Circle of Hell](https://discord.gg/Td59WbfApr)**
